scientific_integrity: Claims of novelty exclude the classical affine incidence identities, general reversible wave construction and projective and complete multipartite wave results; no external independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Even-order fixed-space populations require the binary incidence rank rho, not a claimed closed formula for all non-Desarguesian planes.
No finite check alone proves the general result; the all-order proof is by affine-plane incidence identities and block transfer.
The update is the specified homogeneous linear wave in characteristic two; other characteristics or graph families are not covered.
Unindexed historically equivalent classifications remain possible.
scope: Any finite affine plane of order s>=2, including non-Desarguesian planes, and any extension field of characteristic two; reversible two-row adjacency wave.
title: Affine excision gives eight- and twenty-four-step reversible incidence-wave clocks
